title: Spell Out
description: Stops booking refs, wallet addresses and passwords being misread aloud or copied wrong by grouping the characters, naming look-alikes under the glyph (0 zero vs O oh, 1/l/I, 5/S), spelling it in the NATO alphabet with case when it matters, and flagging Cyrillic look-alike letters and invisible characters.
stops: Booking ref misread over the phone
